text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
All right. 
That's... our first step taken!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact looks relieved 
to have gotten off to a smooth start. 
However, the two watching from the stands—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ooooohhhhh...!! 
Wasn't that incredible, Daring Tact?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that finishing kick?! That 
spurt! 
I can feel such tremendous potential!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I always knew that girl had a 
special spark, 
but still...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What a surprise! 
She really never ceases to amaze me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod in agreement with Daring Heart. 
Indeed, seeing that dynamic, full-body 
running form, 
I could sense immense potential.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, why are you sounding like an 
innocent bystander? 
You're the one who found that diamond in 
the rough, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you polish her up properly. 
Do that... and she'll shine brighter than 
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...She's stronger than you think. 
Have faith in her, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Trainer!
choice_data_list: Great work! That was an amazing run!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Running on an actual racetrack 
feels completely different from running at 
Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Strangely enough, the cheers from the 
crowd 
reached me so clearly... Hehe. 
Epiphaneia's voice was especially loud.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look... 
I'm still trembling...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At first, I thought she was shaking from 
excitement... 
but looking closer, her cheeks are 
flushed, 
and her footing seems somewhat unsteady...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right now the adrenaline is masking it, 
but the toll from that fierce run will hit 
her soon. 
Just as I am about to tell her to head 
back to the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hey! That girl standing over there... 
she's from 
Hillesta Academy, right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Let's go interview her! Also, the girls 
from the famous clubs... 
Yep, list complete. Let's make a move!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...The reporters rush right past us, 
even though Daring Tact had just 
finished her race right beside them.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...O-Oh dear? 
My strength...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm feeling better now. I'm sorry, 
it seems fatigue suddenly washed over me 
all at once...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pressure from rivals, the unique 
atmosphere of the venue... 
In an actual race, all sorts of factors 
weigh heavily on the girls.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, Daring Tact's exhaustion was 
greater than expected. Looking ahead to 
next year, 
for the time being we should—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
I... want to run in lots of races.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Compared to everyone else who debuted at 
the same time, 
I lack experience by a wide margin...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Since I never had the chance to push my 
limits 
against peers in a development club... 
I must close that gap first.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So for the Junior Class, I'd like to ask 
that we focus on entering many races...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I understand Daring Tact's reasoning. 
Girls who belonged to youth clubs 
certainly 
gained valuable experience in junior 
races.
choice_data_list:
(Still, your official careers start at the 
exact same point.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, her full-body running 
style 
places an immense physical burden on her. 
To draw out her true strengths moving 
forward—
choice_data_list:
I want to prioritize conditioning your 
body.

I want to prioritize conditioning your 
body.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh... 
...You mean we should concentrate on 
training?
choice_data_list: So you can unleash your full potential.
So you can unleash your full potential.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Then, as for our target race...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Elfin Stakes takes place in February 
of the Classic Class. 
Since it's on the same track and at the 
same distance as today, 
it should help her clearly gauge her 
growth.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Next February... is it? 
That's quite a ways away...
choice_data_list: No need to rush. Let's take it steady.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. 
Understood!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Bzzz, bzzz, bzzz, bzzz...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
A call from everyone in Hidaka...! 
But Epiphaneia and the others are calling 
too...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: W-What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...! 
What an incredible luxury that would be.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well then... 
I shall happily take you up on that.

title: After the Debut: The First Step
